trace.topic: Dear SaaStr: Should I Use an AI SDR Before I Have a Working Human SDR motion?
trace.goal: Advise founders on whether AI SDRs can substitute for an unproven outbound motion.
expected_facts: The answer should argue that AI cannot fix a broken outbound motion by itself.
It should explain that founders still need a working message, ICP, and qualification logic.
It should allow that AI can accelerate a working system but rarely invent one from nothing.
rubric_must_haves: Explains what parts of the motion must already work.
Uses practical examples or failure modes.
trace.gold_reference: A strong answer should say that founders should not expect an AI SDR to invent a working go-to-market motion. If the ICP, messaging, and follow-up logic are still broken, automating them only scales the noise. AI SDRs work best when there is already a credible human playbook to copy and improve.

Dear SaaStr: I Want to Roll Out an AI SDR. How Do I Start? First, get clear on what you’re actually buying — and what it actually does. We’ve now been running AI SDRs at SaaStr for over a year. Multiple platforms. Real data. Real pipeline. And the honest answer is: it works. But it works very differently than most vendors will tell you, and the gap between a good deployment and a wasted one comes down almost entirely to how you set it up. Here’s what we actually learned. The Single Best Use Case to Start With: The Leads Your Team Is Ignoring
This is the insight that changed how we think about AI SDRs entirely. Your human SDRs are force-ranking in their heads every single day. They’re chasing the big deals, the warm inbound, the accounts that feel like they could close this quarter. The leads they consider “not worth it” — return event attendees, old website visitors, ghosted CRM contacts — those get nothing. Not bad follow-up. Nothing. That’s where AI SDRs absolutely shine. When we deployed AI on the leads our human team refused to work — people who had engaged with SaaStr but never got follow-up — we got a
72% open rate
on Agentforce and generated
15% of our London event revenue
from a segment that would have produced zero without AI. Not 15% incremental lift. 15% of total revenue from leads that were producing $0. So before you start thinking about AI SDRs as a way to scale your best motion, ask yourself: what’s the motion your team isn’t running at all? Start there.

If you hook up an AI SDR and go away and do nothing, you will get nothing. Zilch. Nada. Nothing. Will fail. If you hook up an AI SDR and * train it every day, * every single day, * and keep iterating on anything that works * and give yourself a month to nail it * and make sure you respond to every response it gets ASAP, not ghost prospects that actually respond * make sure the messaging is dynamic and A+, all of it * and audit and read the emails it sends every day * and watch what works and doesn’t every day * and QA the output yourself daily * and be honest is what it is outputting as good or better than a human Well then, it probably will work

"Can AI SDRs really work for outbound?  Yes, but start with what you have:

- Start with traffic on your website
- Try lapsed customers
- Remarket to lapsed customers

Use AI for expansion.

Start your AI Agent on folks in your base no one is following up with now."

95% of human SDRs do not really know the product they are ‘selling’.

95% of human SDRs can’t answer a tough question from a VP Eng, a CPO, a CIO, etc.

95% of human SDRs have to wait until they can grab some human to help you.

This is why AI SDRs will rapidly win.

The productivity benefits are real, too.  Huge.  But the truth is, an AI SDRs is much, much better than a human one.

Almost always.
